DitherPixelArea.values: The values in order, oldest first. They are resampled to the width.
DitherPixelArea.labels: A label per value for the readout, such as dates. Default #1, #2 and so on.
DitherPixelArea.fill: gradient dissolves upward, dotted keeps real gaps, hatched adds diagonals, solid is flat.
DitherPixelArea.min: The bottom and the top of the value axis. max: 0 takes the largest value.
DitherPixelArea.max: The bottom and the top of the value axis. max: 0 takes the largest value.
DitherPixelArea.interactive: The hover lift and the marker with its readout.
DitherPixelArea.animated: The area sweeps in from the left.
DitherPixelArea.stars: A few stars in the fill.
